Title: Azure Stream Analytics—Managed Identity authentication with Power BI

Body.Content:
Stream Analytics now offers full support for managed identity-based authentication with Power BI for dynamic dashboarding experience. While this new feature is immediately available, you still have the option of using the Azure Active Directory user-based authentication model.

Learn more.
